boarding_points.name: Pier do Marco Zero (Praça Rio Branco)
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura do Recife / licensed small-boat crossing operators
boarding_points.notes: The symbolic center of Recife and its Carnival main stage (3.7M attendees 2026). Continuous small-boat crossing to the Brennand sculpture park on the breakwater, R$5.00 round trip (fare recorded in OSM survey; R$2.50/leg at the 2013 municipal boat delivery). Adjacent OSM ferry_terminal node at -8.063168/-34.870812.

boarding_points.name: Pier do Parque de Esculturas Francisco Brennand
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura do Recife (park); crossing served by licensed small boats
boarding_points.notes: Landing pier for the open-air sculpture park (91 Brennand works) on the harbor breakwater, reached only by boat from Marco Zero (OSM route 'Travessia Marco Zero - Parque de Esculturas', charge 5.00 BRL, 07:00-17:00). Park entrance building and visitor info at -8.066029/-34.870153.
boarding_points.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/ (Pier do Parque de Esculturas, amenity=ferry_terminal + ferry route way); https://www2.recife.pe.gov.br/noticias/13/03/2013/prefeitura-faz-entrega-de-11-barcos-do-projeto-marco-zero-brennand

boarding_points.name: Pier do Catamaran Tours (Recife Antigo)
boarding_points.notes: OSM-mapped operator pier on the Recife Antigo waterfront just south of Marco Zero. Catamaran Tours' primary advertised embarkation is Cais de Santa Rita (see recife-catamaran-cais-santa-rita); this Recife Antigo pier is its mapped second berth.
boarding_points.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/ (Pier do Catamaran Tours, amenity=ferry_terminal); https://reservas.catamarantours.com.br/

boarding_points.name: Catamaran Tours berth — Cais de Santa Rita
boarding_points.linked_locale: São José (Cais de Santa Rita quay)
boarding_points.notes: Primary embarkation for Recife's daily river sightseeing circuits ('Cais Santa Rita, s/n - São José' per operator; departures Tue-Sun 11h/14h plus themed night tours, R$90-95 adult). The quay street is OSM-verified (runs ~-8.0695/-34.8752 to -34.8768) and the berth sits within ~200 m of Recife Marina (Cais de Santa Rita 46), but the exact berth position is not verifiable from public map data — coordinates left null rather than guessed.

boarding_points.name: Recife Marina (Novotel Recife Marina complex)
boarding_points.notes: New riverfront hotel-marina complex on Cais de Santa Rita, opened 2024; partnership with Cabanga Iate Clube to develop nautical tourism in Pernambuco. Coordinate is the OSM/Nominatim-verified complex address (hotel building); berth layout/capacity unpublished.
boarding_points.source: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/ (Novotel Recife Marina, Cais de Santa Rita 46); https://www.instagram.com/p/C-_DdhuPjyi/ (Cabanga x Recife Marina partnership)

boarding_points.name: Cabanga Iate Clube de Pernambuco
boarding_points.notes: Recife's flagship yacht club (rated among Brazil's top 100 clubs), host pier for the Refeno Recife-Fernando de Noronha international regatta and Globe 40 round-the-world stopover. OSM marina polygon center.

boarding_points.name: Pernambuco Iate Clube (PIC)
boarding_points.notes: Historic club (the former Casa de Banhos) on the sheltered basin inside the Dique do Recife; Refeno 2024 partner club with Cabanga. OSM marina feature.

boarding_points.name: Iate Clube do Recife
boarding_points.notes: Yacht club on the dique between the Pina basin and Brasília Teimosa; part of the basin's three-club nautical cluster. OSM-verified.

boarding_points.name: Píer Aurora (Rua da Aurora)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Boa Vista / Santo Amaro (Capibaribe west bank)
boarding_points.notes: Public pier on the Capibaribe along Rua da Aurora's pastel waterfront, near the north end of the historic bridge sequence — the natural urban-river stop closest to the shelved Rios da Gente north-corridor alignment (Rua do Sol station across the river). OSM man_made=pier.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Marítimo de Passageiros do Recife (Porto do Recife)
boarding_points.notes: Cruise passenger terminal ~400 m north of Marco Zero: 19 calls / 30,000+ passengers in the 2024/25 season; a new R$10M passenger terminal was announced in Aug 2025. OSM ferry_terminal way (Armazém 7).
boarding_points.source: https://www.openstreetmap.org/ (Terminal Marítimo de Passageiros do Recife); https://www.panrotas.com.br/mercado/cruzeiros/2025/08/porto-do-recife-tera-novo-terminal-de-passageiros-no-valor-de-r-10-milhoes_220449.html

boarding_points.name: Estação Fluvial Derby (Rios da Gente — never completed)
boarding_points.operator: Governo de Pernambuco (Secretaria das Cidades) — project shelved
boarding_points.notes: One of the two first-phase stations (Derby and Santana) of the R$289M Capibaribe navigability program (west corridor: Estação Central metro ↔ Iputinga/BR-101 via Derby, Torre, Santana). Works started 2013, <2% executed by 2021, station works described as ruined, program shelved by 2022. Exact riverbank site not verifiable from public map data — coordinates left null rather than guessed. Included as the anchor for the planned-corridor route only.
